context_diary: The account_lookup function handles multiple entity types (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) with flexible return fields. It supports count-only queries for aggregation and can filter by type with limit parameters. This pattern allows efficient multi-step data retrieval across different account hierarchies in a single workflow.
